title: Why your phone is secretly an AI supercomputer

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your phone isn't just a device—it's an AI supercomputer running protocols like 5G and neural networks in real time. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Your phone is just a tool. It doesn't think, learn, or act on its own. It executes commands, not intelligence. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Think again—on-device AI like Apple’s Core ML and Google’s Tensorflow Lite process data locally, making it faster and more secure. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That doesn’t make it a supercomputer. It’s optimized for specific tasks, not general intelligence or autonomous decision-making. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your phone is a platform, not a mind. (4 sec)
